shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: I currently have equal quantities (1 each) of A, B, and C. Trading away my only A for a second B would leave me with 0 A, 2 B, 1 C - reducing variety and leaving me with zero of a good, which lowers my utility given my preference for balanced holdings. I'd rather keep an even distribution unless I get something that increases variety or a good I'm short on.
